name: Punchline
summary:
Punchline is a free online meme caption party game played in the web browser. Each round, every player is dealt a random meme template and writes a caption before the timer runs out. The memes are then revealed anonymously, everyone votes thumbs up, meh or thumbs down, and each player hands out a Meme King crown. After the last round, the round winners face off in the Ultimate Punchline.

Games take 2 to 16 players, who join from their own phones or computers with a link or a four-letter room code, and up to 50 more can watch and vote as the audience. There is also a solo mode against up to five AI-powered computer players, and a public mode for playing with strangers. The library has more than 2 500 meme templates, including animated GIFs and TV and film clips. The game has no adverts, needs no account, and is funded by player donations.
